console.help:
Commands:
  status                    show core status
  list                      list installed plugins
  show <plugin ref>         details of one plugin (declared / granted / missing permission points)
  install <dir|.spc file>   install; flags: --source <origin> / --grant <permission> / --accept-key-change
  uninstall <plugin ref>    uninstall
  reload <plugin ref>       reload
  enable | disable <ref>    enable / disable
  grant | revoke <ref> <points>...  grant / revoke permission points
  source list | add | remove | enable | disable | alias | anchor   source management
  stop                      shut down; exit / quit are aliases
  help                      show this text
